title: FTEST shares F.TEST's larger-variance-first two-tailed ratio and singleton-validation order
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, FTEST(array1, array2) is the compatibility alias of F.TEST: it validates single-cell blank/error arguments in formula order, collects finite numbers from each array (ignoring text, logicals, and blanks in ranges), returns #DIV/0! when either sample has < 2 numbers or zero variance, orients the variance ratio larger-variance-first, and returns 2 * min(P(F > f), P(F <= f)) from one incomplete-beta call. Matches 2,849/2,849 full-bank FTEST rows.
basis: Measured across all 2,849 full-bank FTEST rows in Excel 16.0.20527 (CalcFunc-Evidence bank2-answers-ftest-{scalar,more,special}.json) and prefix_metadata (row 92).
